ios.desc:
Less brainrot. More living. SandBud is a focus app that makes putting your phone down REWARDING. 

Block distracting apps, and earn rewards when you focus. The best part? You can grow your own zen garden and show off your focus progress while you are resetting your phone habit. 

Designed by the former TikTok product team, SandBud makes focus fun! We use proven behavioral psychology hacks to reverse-engineer the brainrot, so you will fall in love with being present again! 

Meet Bud, your little focus butler. He’s here to remind you to spend less time scrolling and more time doing your thing. Studying. Working. Having dinner without checking what everyone else is having for dinner. 

HOW SandBud WORKS

Choose your distractions
Select the apps you want to take a break from.
Make a focus plan
Set aside time for work, study, winding down, or being with people you care about. TimeBack blocks your selected apps during your focus session, so you don't brainrot.
Earn something worth looking forward to
Complete your focus session to earn rewards for your garden. Grow plants, unlock surprise collections, and make your little space your own.

SCREEN TIME CONTROL WITH SOMETHING TO LOOK FORWARD TO

You already know you want to scroll less and stop the brainrot. 
SandBud gives you a reason to follow through: a little progress, a little surprise, and a garden that grows with your effort.

• App Blocker — Block distracting apps when you want to focus.
• Focus Plans — Make room in your day for the things you keep putting off.
• Zen Garden — Turn completed sessions into rewards and a space you can build.
• Surprise Collections — Discover new things to unlock as you keep going.
• Zen Mode — Start a distraction-free moment when you need one.
• Screen Time Reports — See your screen time breakdown and follow your progress.

BE PRESENT, ONE SESSION AT A TIME

One quick check can turn into an hour of brainrot. Give yourself a break from the feed and make room for your own life.

Practice mindfulness while studying, working, or spending time with someone you love. Your phone can wait. Bud is excellent at waiting.

Start your first focus plan. Give your attention somewhere better to go.

BUILT WITH APPLE’S SCREEN TIME API

SandBud uses Apple’s Screen Time API to block the apps you select.

TERMS & PRIVACY

Terms of Use: https://gettimeback.app/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://gettimeback.app/privacy-policy/

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I used to be super addicted to social media and doomscrolling. My phone addiction got so bad that my screen time literally became a full-time job (8 hours a day, no joke).

So, I built TimeBack. It's an app to help you fix your phone addiction with a zen garden game.

Here’s how it works:

- Block distracting apps

- Stick to your focus plan to unlock surprise decorations and design your own zen garden

Think of it as touching grass without having to go outside.

Give it a try and let me know what you think!
